build_nvemd_reducer: build an NVEMDReducer instance to reduce NVE molecular dynamics benchmark results by total energy drift
run_get_te_drift: run get_te_drift on an NVE MD trajectory file to compute total energy drift in meV/atom/ps
run_moving_avg: run moving_avg on a numpy array to compute a sliding window moving average for smoothing
test_join_results: test NVEMDReducer join_results to collect total energy drift values from multiple trajectory files via glob
test_compute_metrics: test NVEMDReducer compute_metrics to calculate mean drift_mev_per_atom_ps from a list of drift results
